content_manifest.canonical_format: UTF-8 lines sorted as path, private Git blob SHA-1, public Git blob SHA-1 separated by TAB and terminated by LF

excluded_paths: private-only A1/A2/MQ/Gate2 implementation, configuration, tests, and architecture/scientific documents
private databases, logs, environment files, credentials, provider payloads, generated evidence, and workstation paths
all private-source files not named in mirrored_paths
sanitization_notes: The retained Gate2 evidence ZIP and its manifest are private and were not copied.
Private A1/A2 implementation is prohibited from the public mirror by current private authority and was not copied.
The public application and test baseline remains the previously published pre-A1 commit; it is not tree-equivalent to the private source.

The public Docker job exercises the established public baseline with an exact private Dockerfile, runtime lock, entrypoint, compose file, and verifier, but cannot certify the intentionally excluded private application tree.

The exact-content workflow limits its private-equivalence claim to mirrored_paths. The existing public quality workflow may test additional historical public files without claiming private equivalence.
